APPROVE
`Read` is now a single loop with one guarded `continue` (well under 15), the extracted `Reader` keeps the same branch order, state resets and line numbers, and it uses only members a nested class can reach; the one assumption I could not check against the full file is that `IsDependencySection` matches exactly the `dependencies`/`devDependencies`/`optionalDependencies` set it replaces.
